_comment: Reference copy of data/remote_compute.json — the HF Jobs remote-compute
config. The real file is NOT in git: data/ is a symlink to the jobs volume
(D:\vaultwares-studio-jobs\data), so git will not traverse into it, and the
path is gitignored besides. Copy this file to data/remote_compute.json and
fill in your own namespace to enable remote execution.
No secrets belong in this file. The Hugging Face token is read from the OS
to the HF_TOKEN env var — see runners/hf_jobs.py get_hf_token().
Losing this file is not loud: HfJobsConfig.load() silently returns
enabled=False, and the reconstruction stage then falls through to the local
quick path and writes 4-vertex placeholder PLYs instead of raising. That is
what happened on 2026-07-13 — two runs 'succeeded' with no remote job ever
submitted. If a remote run produces a placeholder, check this file first.
